$comment: TF-C112 (D-FFI-PE-CRT-UCRT-MIGRATION) -- RUNTIME witness that re-declaring a shipped symbol the platform realizes as a COMPILER-SYNTHESIZED SHIM still yields a binary that LOADS and runs, baseline AND the `release` shippedPipeline arm. THE DEFECT: a shipped descriptor row declares two INDEPENDENT things -- where the symbol resolves (`library`) and whether it is an import AT ALL (`synthesize`). Goal-2 gives a user re-declaration authority over the SIGNATURE, never over the platform's REALIZATION, but the bare-prototype extern synthesis forwarded only the library and then emitted a plain import regardless. MEASURED against the real DLL (objdump -p C:\Windows\System32\ucrtbase.dll): ucrtbase exports NO bare printf/fprintf/sprintf/vfprintf/sscanf, only the `__stdio_common_v*` cores those five names are shimmed over -- while msvcrt.dll, the PRE-flip binding, exports all five, which is exactly why this channel sat open and inert until the UCRT flip made it lethal. DSS eagerly imports every declared shipped extern (D-FFI-DESCRIPTOR-EAGER-IMPORT), so naming one of the five is not a build error at all: MEASURED at the TF-C111 HEAD on `#include <stdio.h>` + `int printf(const char*, ...);` + one call, the compile returned rc=0 with NO diagnostic at any stage, objdump -p showed `printf` sitting in the ucrtbase import table beside its four correctly-shimmed siblings, and the binary died at PROCESS START with 0xC0000139. WHY A RUNNABLE ARTIFACT: a compile-only test sees a clean rc=0 in BOTH the broken and the fixed world -- the difference appears the instant the loader is asked to resolve the import table, so only an example that actually runs can witness it. WHY ALL FIVE NAMES ARE RE-DECLARED: each pe stdio recipe is a separate synth arm over a different UCRT core, and each has its own way to be wrong -- printf goes to __stdio_common_vfprintf via the __acrt_iob_func(1) accessor; fprintf to the same core with a CALLER-supplied FILE*; vfprintf to the same core again but as the ONE non-variadic arm, forwarding a declared `ap` verbatim; sprintf to __stdio_common_vsprintf with the unbounded (size_t)-1 count; sscanf to __stdio_common_vsscanf. Re-declaring only printf would leave four arms unwitnessed on this channel. Every prototype here is byte-for-byte what <stdio.h> declares, so all five are legal C that clang and GCC accept -- DSS must accept them too AND keep the platform's realization. NOT A DUPLICATE of shipped_printf_ucrt, which exercises the INJECTED path (include + call) and pins the UCRT-vs-msvcrt formatting divergence; that sibling stayed green throughout the entire period this defect was live. NOT A DUPLICATE of bare_proto_shipped_redecl either, which pins the LIBRARY riding a suppressed row (`puts`, a real ucrtbase export with no recipe, so it can never reach the arm under test here). CROSS-TARGET: the identical source takes the ORDINARY suppressed-import path on elf/macho (glibc and libSystem export real printf/fprintf/...; those rows carry no `synthesize` tag), so the same bytes must come out on all four targets -- which makes this a per-format agreement check as well as a pe load check, and pins the fix as descriptor-data-driven rather than format-keyed. ANTI-FOLD: every formatted operand is a mutable global rather than a literal argument (the shipped_printf_ucrt convention), so the `release` arm cannot collapse the calls into precomputed text and leave a witness that witnesses nothing. RETURN COUNTS ARE PLATFORM-INVARIANT and that is measured, not hoped for: Windows text-mode streams translate \n to \r\n but the Microsoft CRT returns the count BEFORE translation, so one set of constants is correct everywhere and the CRLF divergence is carried entirely by the per-target `expectedStdout` (the shipped_atexit convention; manifest pin = pe CRLF, each elf/macho target overrides with LF). THE CONSTANTS ARE NOT SELF-CERTIFIED: this exact source was compiled and run by REAL gcc 14.2.0 at -O2 (mingw-w64, linking msvcrt) -- identical stdout, exit 42 -- so every `n != <count>` is confirmed by a different compiler against a different CRT, and the five re-declarations are confirmed legal C by a toolchain that rejects an incompatible one (gcc -fsyntax-only on `int printf(const char*);` over the same header: "error: conflicting types for 'printf'", which is exactly the set DSS's own H_ShippedShimSignatureMismatch refuses). Nothing here is precision-sensitive, so the msvcrt reference is a valid oracle for this example; the UCRT-vs-msvcrt formatting divergence is shipped_printf_ucrt's job. RED-ON-DISABLE: drop the `recipeId` carry from the analyzer's goal-2 arm (or the recipe arm from the CST->HIR bare-proto synthesis) and the pe64 arms emit an `ExternImport{printf, ucrtbase.dll}` -- the compile still succeeds and the run dies at load with 0xC0000139, which is precisely the failure mode this example exists to catch. exit = 42; a distinct code per check (50..59).
